summary: NRX Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 5,714,286 shares of common stock at $3.50 per share, with an over-allotment option of up to 857,142 shares. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing S-3 shelf registration, not a special situation. Proceeds before expenses are approximately $18.8M. Shares are listed on Nasdaq. The underwriting discount is $0.21 per share. This is an ordinary equity offering, not a spin-off, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation category.
